transcript: Today my boyfriend Paul and I saw summer 1976 on Broadway, a new play produced by MTC that recounts the story of 2 women who became close friends in 1976. The play is mostly the 2 of them narrating some of the key events of their friendship, interspersed with them reenacting various conversations, phone calls, etc. Although they were really close for a short period of time when their daughters were young friends, they end up growing apart. But the play is really a love letter to friendship and how people can come into our lives even for a short period of time, teach us new things about ourselves and the world, and have a profound lifelong impact on us. A quick 90 minutes with no intermission. This play is simple but engaging and really well performed. With that, another playbill for my collection.
